DISCUSS: How The Gators Sealed And Secured A 52-28 Rout Of No. 4 Ole Miss With a Pick, Again
Eddie Gilley breaks down the five plays that decided Florida's 52-28 rout of No. 4 Ole Miss, from a blown fourth-down gamble to DJ Coleman's game-sealing interception.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/how-the-gators-sealed-and-secured-a-52-28-rout-of-no-4-ole-miss-with-a-pick-again
By Eddie Gilley. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
